subject: Q3 executive hiring slate — sign-off, comp bands, and contingency
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, mina_haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 May 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Q3 executive hiring slate — sign-off, comp bands, and contingency

Team — attaching the proposed Q3 executive slate and the comp-band guardrails. This is the version I promised after the hiring sync. High-level ask: please review and sign off (or flag changes) by EOD Friday so we can push offers to recruiting partners and get approvals into DocuSign next week.

Summary (see attachment for row-level detail):
- Headcount ask: 6 executive-level roles (3 leaders for Product/Infra/Sales, 2 senior ICs for ML infra, 1 Head of Partnerships).
- Budget impact: incremental run-rate ~ $2.1M fully loaded (salaries + hiring admin + onboarding allowances).
- Comp bands: recommended ranges and offer caps per role in comp_band_guardrails.pdf. We used the 60/20/20 midpoint tilt for competitive closing without breaking comp corridors.
- Contingency: proposed fallback hiring plan if Q3 revenue misses target: freeze 2 leadership hires and reallocate 1 senior IC to a critical infra hire. Details in the contingency tab of the spreadsheet.

Open questions I want your input on:
1) Are we comfortable with the proposed comp caps for VP-level roles vs. market benchmarks? (Marcus + Mina)
2) Can the CEO office support sign-off on a one-time $30k sign-on above cap for key hires if needed? (Aditya & Vivek)
3) Any objections to pausing the Head of Partnerships hire and instead expanding the partner PM headcount later? (Laura + Marcus)

Next steps if we get sign-off by Friday:
- I will bundle final offer templates and route to Legal + Finance for pre-approval.
- Recruiting partners (Harrison at TalentBridge) will start candidate outreach on Monday.
- DocuSign envelopes for VP roles to be created Tues if approvals are in.

Attachments (stubs):
- Q3_exec_headcount_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet with per-role salary band, budget line, justification)
- comp_band_guardrails.pdf (reference comp bands and cap rules)

Thanks — looking to close this quickly to keep hiring momentum.

—
Dylan Brooks
Director, GTM Strategy
Redwood Inference

From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, mina_haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 May 2028 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 executive hiring slate — sign-off, comp bands, and contingency

Dylan — thanks for the crisp package. Quick read-through comments: solid rationale overall, I’m supportive of moving forward with the slate with the following caveats.

- Approve the slate pending Finance confirms the run-rate impact fits with the Q3 forecast (Finance to confirm by Friday).
- On the $30k one-time sign-on above cap: okay for critical hires (up to two) but route approvals through my office first. Vivek, please coordinate.
- If revenue variance > -6% by the May 25 review, we implement the contingency (freeze 2 leadership hires).

Please proceed with recruiting outreach. If Finance sign-off is a blocker, pause offers that require non-standard sign-on.

Aditya
CEO, Redwood Inference

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 May 2028 08:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 executive hiring slate — sign-off, comp bands, and contingency

Thanks for pulling this together, Dylan. A couple of items from People Ops/Comp perspective: 

- The comp_band_guardrails.pdf looks good but we should add an explicit note about market adjustment timing (we usually rebench mid-year). Recommend we add a 5% buffer to the VP bands for candidates with current comp above midpoint.
- For offer approvals: People Ops will need the final candidate job profile and current comp data before we route to DocuSign. Please ask recruiters to collect that pre-emptively.
- Contingency plan: instead of freezing 2 leadership hires immediately, can we make the freeze conditional on the May 25 revenue checkpoint? That aligns with Aditya's note but helps with candidate experience (keeps discussions warm).

Minor edit request inline: in the matrix, row for "Head of Partnerships" — please move the target hire window from July to Aug to reflect recruiting resource constraints.

I’ll prep the offer templates once you confirm the final bands and candidate docs.

—
Mina Haddad
Head of People Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, mina_haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Harrison Cole <harrison@talentbridge.com>, offers@lawsonpartners.com
Date: Fri, 12 May 2028 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 executive hiring slate — sign-off, comp bands, and contingency

Team — thanks for the quick turnaround and feedback. Short summary and actions (finalized after inline comments):

1) Approvals: Aditya approves proceeding, contingent on Finance run-rate confirmation. Vivek noted sign-on exceptions require CEO office routing. Marcus had no objections. Mina requested the 5% buffer for VP bands — accepted and updated.
2) Headcount timing: Moved Head of Partnerships target from July -> August per Mina. Contingency will be conditional on the May 25 revenue checkpoint (we won’t implement an automatic freeze today).
3) Recruiter outreach: Harrison (copied) will begin candidate outreach Monday with the updated bands. Harrison — please collect current comp and profile before first outreach.
4) DocuSign: I will assemble DocuSign envelopes for the VP roles once Finance confirms run-rate (expected by Friday). Attestation: legal will have standard clauses; offers requiring > cap or sign-on above $20k will be flagged for Aditya's sign-off.

Next immediate action items:
- Marcus/Finance: confirm run-rate fit by EOD Friday (May 19) — Marcus, can you confirm?
- Mina/People Ops: prepare offer templates with the 5% VP buffer and provide to Recruiting by Monday.
- Recruiters (Harrison): collect candidate comp snapshots and return to Mina/Dylan before sending offers.

If we get all confirmations, target first offer batch the week of May 22. I’ll follow up with the DocuSign links and a short tracker.

Attachments referenced: Q3_exec_headcount_matrix.xlsx, comp_band_guardrails.pdf (both updated inline).

—
Dylan Brooks
Director, GTM Strategy
Redwood Inference
